name: PCP Refund - Car Finance Claims
description: Check eligibility and submit claims for mis-sold PCP car finance compensation in the UK. FCA regulated (FRN: 912323). Average refund GBP 1,100. No Win No Fee.

authentication.description: Consumer tools require no authentication. Application submissions are server-side verified (Kount) and forwarded to the R2R affiliate API with an X-API-KEY header held server-side.
authentication.partnerAccess: API key (X-API-KEY header) or OAuth2 client-credentials (scopes: claims:write, products:read, info:read). Contact info@jigsawclaims.co.uk to register.

tools.name: check_pcp_eligibility
tools.description: Submit a consumer PCP/HP car finance mis-selling eligibility enquiry. Requires consumer consent to process the enquiry.

tools.name: get_loan_products
tools.description: List the loan/claims products offered, filterable by type (pcp, hp, loan) with pagination.

tools.name: get_loan_quote
tools.description: Illustrative repayment estimate for a car finance agreement (principal, term, annual rate). Estimate only.

tools.name: get_pcp_claim_info
tools.description: Get information about PCP car finance mis-selling claims, eligibility criteria, average compensation amounts, and how the claim process works.

topic.description: The topic to get information about

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Get the latest news and updates about the FCA investigation into PCP car finance mis-selling, court rulings, and consumer guidance.
